text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O, who joined the academy at the same time as me, chases after her role model Maruzen, hoping to one day race her!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Since we both have someone we want to challenge one day, we make a promise to work hard and support each other's dreams!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You know, Yaeno and Chiyono O's eyes both shine so bright when they talk about their dreams! Now I wanna make my own dreams come true even more!
